releaseNotes: Compact 56-pixel application rows show at least five entries at the default window size.
Moved per-application controls into a shared selection panel with equally sized action buttons.
Fixed selected-row contrast, unified Rajdhani typography, and styled vertical and horizontal scrollbars.
Kept long errors in a fixed-height panel; selection changes now discard unapplied mode edits safely.
Updated README screenshots and added layout checks for selection, button bounds, and visible row count.
